name: criterion-1
text: Criterion 1 (O-1A 1, EB-1A i): nationally or internationally recognized prizes or awards for excellence.

Counts (C1-award-competitive): a competitive award with a named issuer and stated selection criteria: a hackathon or pitch-competition win; YC or accelerator acceptance (see decisions-5-5); merit-based selections. Awards limited to young or early-career people count.
Needs attorney (C1-no-selection-criteria): an award whose issuer states no selection criteria.

Rejected: SAFE or angel funding as an award (T-funding-not-award, counts toward #8 instead); participation certificates (T-participation-certificate); self-nominated or pay-to-enter awards (T-pay-to-enter).
Signals: Gmail from the issuer domain; issuer posts on LinkedIn.
